_comment: Cards for tests/unit/counters/test_enters_with_counters_per_angel.py. `t_giada` is Giada, Font of Hope whole. `t_angel` is a {W} Angel to cast, `t_squire` the same body without the type, `t_angel_pair` makes two Angel tokens in one op (one simultaneous event) at instant speed, and `t_mass_return` puts every creature card in your graveyard onto the battlefield at once.
